findings.title: Acceptance claims need cross-check
findings.message: The editor-ax check is documented with a 90s timeout but ran 62s against a 60s fixture lifetime; this is fine, but the recorded sdk-runtime check has a 180s timeout. More importantly, the README states 'All eight scripted native invocations pass' while acceptance.json lists nine native_checks (cycle, soak, endurance, document, editor-ax, text, starter, sdk-runtime = eight). Count verification is inconsistent with the narrative about 'native_checks' and the 'text' summary lacks a corresponding result field consistency.
findings.suggestion: Reconcile the counts and keep README and JSON in sync, ideally generated from the JSON.

findings.title: Residual window entry in cleanup not explained
findings.message: The soak sample_last shows Completed 0 and the cleanup window entry remains listed with a nonzero WindowNumber; the 'Windows' array contains one entry in cleanup for both runs while docs claim 'managed AX windows are zero'. The leftover window record (invisible) is not explained.
findings.suggestion: Document that the residual window record is a retired NSWindow shell, or confirm it is released.

findings.title: Endurance result shows nonzero Dispatching at completion
findings.message: The endurance result reports pending.Dispatching = 1 at completion, while docs claim zero active workers and clean terminal state. A nonzero dispatching counter may indicate an unretired in-flight dispatch, contradicting the 'terminal cleanup' claims.
findings.suggestion: Explain why Dispatching is 1 at completion or investigate; document it in the report.
